papers.name: SceneWeaver
papers.title: SceneWeaver: All-in-One 3D Scene Synthesis with an Extensible and Self-Reflective Agent
papers.official_proof: 作者项目Code与论文同名仓库、机构/作者互证。
papers.paper_facts: An extensible ReAct-style agent selects scene tools, receives VLM reflections and uses an Infinigen/Blender physics-aware executor. The paper caps experiments at ten iterations, memory length one; reports mean 64 minutes per scene and about seven iterations, not a one-pass generator. Evaluation separates object count, outside-object count and colliding-pair count from GPT-4 visual realism/functionality/layout/completeness, with human and simulation checks. Main tests use common rooms and eight open-vocabulary types. This is free-composition prompt generation, not exact unknown-size inventory enforcement.
mechanisms: relation-aware mesh executor and physics post-optimization
papers.input_output: prompt→tool-selected layout/assets/scene；tool可自行增加对象。公开主CLI未提供FastFill式完整inventory/shell协议。

public_scope.status: 完整可见实现/工具/部分evaluation入口，仍需复杂依赖和资产。

files.role: 实际max_steps默认15；L508循环，不能当论文十步配置

public_scope.command: 在Pipeline目录配置后执行 python main.py --prompt 'Design me a bedroom.' --cnt 1 --basedir OUTPUT
public_scope.artifacts: 有源码和示例scene/工具路径；未验证外部模型/资产包完整下载与全部实验复现。

papers.evaluation_caveats: #CN是碰撞对数量，不能替换参与碰撞对象率；自由增加物体会影响丰富度/碰撞数，不能与固定清单直接混排行。
papers.relevance: 直接覆盖critic/反思/多工具工作流、物理repair。“加agent/critic”不是独立创新；约一小时流程不适合用户希望的轻量pipeline。
papers.fit: 背景近邻高；轻量主baseline低。要做同输入对照需锁定清单/真实shell并限制工具与预算。
not_verified: 当前repo默认15步与论文10步配置的准确复现

papers.name: Reason-3D
papers.title: Text-to-Scene with Large Reasoning Models
papers.official_proof: AAAI原论文首页Code明确ETH-DISCO/reason-3d；repo作者和论文一致。
papers.paper_facts: Off-the-shelf Gemini 2.5 performs retrieval, priority planning, sequential pose generation and collision-aware revision without task-specific training. Placement uses names, asset sizes and rotated AABBs, with no rendered visual feedback; benign bbox overlaps can be retained semantically. Separate experiments test retrieval top-k, fixed-object placement and full text-to-scene generation, mainly with human comparisons. The fixed-placement comparison supplies identical objects to LayoutVLM. It assumes approximately correct relative asset scales and upright alignment, and does not generate architecture. Calls scale with objects, rather than one constant model call.
mechanisms: geometric collision list fed back to LRM
papers.input_output: text+room dimensions+asset database→retrieved assets/positions/3-axis rotations；固定object placement子实验已给asset尺寸。

public_scope.status: 公开preprocessing、retrieval、placement、rendering代码；未找到独立paper benchmark/human-study汇总脚本。

files.role: 检测AABB交叠并逐对象修正

public_scope.dependencies: Gemini API、embedding/caption资产预处理、Blender4.3.2；没有需训练的专用layout权重。
public_scope.caution: 未执行API，不能将模型版本/推理tokens或N对象的成本等同一次GPT坐标输出。

papers.evaluation_caveats: 检索top-k基于目标asset identity，布局人评另测；不要把选资产强项当相同家具布局强项。论文附录collision-free命名与描述需用发布实现另固定分母。
papers.relevance: 应增加强reasoning baseline，不能只战胜旧LayoutGPT。直接数字布局＋collision feedback已有先例；其语义接受bbox overlap提醒我们避免过强盒子repair。
papers.fit: 高：强off-the-shelf文本推理对照；主任务仍需显式固定inventory、真实polygon/door约束和未知尺寸处理。

papers.name: MetaSpatial
papers.title: MetaSpatial: Reinforcing 3D Spatial Reasoning in VLMs for the Metaverse
papers.official_proof: 原论文直接给PzySeere/MetaSpatial；作者主页列ICLR2026。
papers.paper_facts: The current paper formulates given room image plus objects annotated with category, size and material, outputting object XYZ placements. Physics, format and GPT-4o rendering rewards train Qwen2.5-VL 3B/7B. Its 3D-SPO uses object-coordinate token modulation and training-only multi-turn trajectories; final comparisons use single-turn inference. Metrics include object collision/constraint violation ratios and five visual criteria. Thus learned spatial reasoning without heavy inference repair is already a direct prior, but predicting unknown dimensions and full pose is outside its stated XYZ formulation.
mechanisms: RL rather than unique-reference pose supervision
papers.input_output: room image+已给对象metadata和尺寸/偏好→固定对象XYZ；不等同文字清单未知size/yaw。

public_scope.status: 公开GRPO训练框架、数据构造、渲染/physics reward和HF数据；未确认公开可下载的finetuned checkpoint，未验证当前commit覆盖最新论文全部3D-SPO。

papers.name: DirectLayout
papers.title: Direct Numerical Layout Generation for 3D Indoor Scene Synthesis via Spatial Reasoning
papers.paper_facts: Text and room dimensions produce BEV layouts, lifted 3D poses/sizes and asset prompts. A Qwen2.5-32B BEV generator is CoT-trained and preference-optimized with VLM plus reasoning-LLM feedback. Iterative asset-layout alignment later adjusts size, pose and orientation using rendered assets. Evaluation covers 15 categories/three prompts, object OOB/collision rates, positional/rotational coherence, PSA, CLIP and anonymized expert ratings. The inference timing section includes Trellis asset generation, so it must be separated from layout-only cost. Joint numeric size prediction and asset-aware refinement are already present.
papers.input_output: 描述+矩形room dimensions→预测size/position/orientation+asset prompts；比asset-given方法更接近未知尺寸任务，但未原生处理完整异形空壳/门窗。

public_scope.status: 流程代码公开；论文训练的专用模型明确不发布，因此发布版不是可复现论文trained-model数字的开箱baseline。

papers.name: Imaginarium
papers.title: Imaginarium: Vision-guided High-Quality 3D Scene Layout Generation
papers.official_proof: 作者项目/作者博客与原文指向HiHiAllen/Imaginarium。
papers.paper_facts: A library-aligned image generator expands text, then semantic/geometric image parsing retrieves assets and estimates transformations. Scene-graph local refinement, global translation optimization and Blender physics produce a coherent scene. The paper reports about 240 seconds on one A100. Evaluation separates art-student preferences, professional richness ratings and reconstruction from rendered reference images. Reconstruction uses object/category recovery, rotation/translation AUC, graph relations and visual similarity; it is distinct from free plausible layout quality. The method is image-guided asset-library synthesis, not fixed textual inventory with a given true shell.
papers.input_output: text→image→3D layout，或image→3D layout；从预定义asset library选物体。输入真实shell/精确inventory需额外约束。

public_scope.status: 实际CLI、模块、数据、FLUX LoRA和derived weights都有可见发布；不是只有README。

synthesis: VLM critic/自反思/多工具闭环已有SceneWeaver；无需再把“加入critic/agent”包装成新意。
不用专门训练的强推理模型已有Reason-3D；轻量方法必须与现代reasoning baseline比较，而不只旧LayoutGPT/Holodeck。
训练期多轮修正→推理期单轮已有MetaSpatial；未知尺寸、完整pose和实际shell约束才是需要明确检验的任务区别。
DirectLayout已做直接数字size/pose、CoT学习和asset-layout alignment；但专用模型不发布，当前GitHub是API替代流程。
Imaginarium提供真实数据/权重/模块，但其视觉引导和重建评估与固定家具全布局协议不同。
